title: approval_input_v1
description: Approval linked to an incident, the evaluated diagnosis hash, and the base commit. Interactive mode records an explicit local confirmation; orchestrated mode authenticates the approval in the host adapter before validation.

channel_type.description: Approval source channel. The plugin records explicit local confirmation in interactive mode; external approval-channel integrations are implemented by the host.

external_reference.description: Verifiable reference to the source confirmation or approval-channel record.

signature.description: Authentication material when the orchestrated host uses a document signature. A host may instead verify identity out of band before validation.

base_commit.description: Approved base commit. Required when decision=APPROVED (the Approval Validator rejects an approval that is not bound to a base commit); irrelevant when decision=REJECTED.
